messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — changelog cutoff is EOD Wednesday (48h). We need a final pass on SDK, sample apps, and the quickstart docs. Who's taking ownership for each?

Chris: I can take Android sample app. PR open: #456, but blocked on a runtime API tweak from @eng-runtime. :eyes:

Aditya: I'll own the web sample updates. Waiting on the runtime change too — @eng-runtime said they'd have a proposal by tomorrow. I can wire the new streaming param once we have the contract.

Rachel: Docs/quickstarts owner here. I'll update the quickstart guide after the web sample PR merges. Plan: publish docs draft Thu AM, finalize after SDK tag.

Samir: SDK code owner — pinging @Chris and @Aditya for reviews on SDK PR 1023. CI is failing linting and a new type error in the client builder. Small patch incoming. :construction_worker:

Zoe: QA check — we need test vectors for the streaming `response_mode` change. Rachel, can you add the sample prompts to the docs repo under `tests/fixtures/streaming/`?

Maria: Good. Also need one person to own the changelog notes (short bullets). Could be a shared doc — I'll start a draft at https://docs.internal/redwood/devex/changelog-draft and add a section for each owner.

Chris: I can add the Android bullet and the sample app link. Will also call out the SDK minor breaking change.

Aditya: Web sample bullet done once PR merged. Note: web sample needs `localStorage` fallback for older browsers — adding a one-line note.

Rachel: Small request: can someone verify the quickstart code block below is the canonical snippet we ship? If so I’ll paste it in the guide.

```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'rw/fastchat-v1', messages })
```

Samir: That snippet looks good, except new `timeoutMs` param is optional now — maybe show it in an advanced example.

Olivia: Heads-up from infra: Dedicated customers need a note about rollout timelines and config keys for VPC. I'll add a bullet to the draft and ping sales.

devex-bot: Reminder: changelog freeze in 24 hours. Final edits must be in the `changelog-draft` doc or they won't make the release.

Maria: Action items recap: Chris = Android sample + changelog bullet; Aditya = web sample + changelog bullet; Rachel = quickstart publish + add fixtures; Samir = land lint/type fixes and finalize SDK PR; Zoe = QA vectors; Olivia = enterprise/VPC note. If anyone wants to swap, shout now. Otherwise I'll mark owners in the draft. :white_check_mark:

Chris: Acked. I'll try to get the review done by EOD today.

Aditya: Ack, will follow up once eng-runtime posts the API proposal.

Rachel: Will aim for Thu AM publish, but will push earlier if SDK tag lands.

Samir: Cutting a patch branch now, will @-mention when CI goes green.

Zoe: QA will start smoke tests after the SDK patch lands.

Maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. If something slips, escalate here and we’ll decide fallback (cutting changelog note, rollback of sample change, or docs-only patch).
